title: Quick Jammy Italian Chicken Saltimbocca
description: A flexitarian-friendly Italian dish featuring chicken, sriracha, and a jammy sauce, served as a solo dinner, inspired by the Calabrian region and the classic Saltimbocca recipe, with a double-fry KFC twist.
instructions: Pound the chicken breasts thin and season with salt and pepper.
Dip each chicken breast in the flour, then the eggs, and finally the breadcrumbs.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and double-fry the chicken breasts until golden brown and crispy.
In a small bowl, mix the sriracha sauce and jam to create a jammy sauce.
Add the prosciutto slices to the skillet and cook until crispy.
Add the chopped sage leaves to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Assemble the Saltimbocca by placing a chicken breast on each plate, topping with a prosciutto slice, a spoonful of the jammy sauce, and a sprinkle of sage leaves.
Garnish with additional sage leaves and prosciutto slices if desired.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
